An action that Flies and forces nearby creatures to save or be pushed; only targets are affected.

Waives the Aid preparation requirement; a rules exception on an action, with no numeric effect on the sheet.

Grants weapon familiarity: bola, sap, and whip (all martial in core.json) count as simple weapons for proficiency; nothing delivers it. The nonlethal-penalty waiver is a rules exception and the precision damage is conditional.

Rewrites the effects of the Black Tentacles spell on its targets; no player statistic changes.
Reaction to Shove or Trip an adjacent creature; grants an action, affects only the target.

An action that sets you alight; the riders apply only while you are taking persistent fire damage, scale per weapon damage die, and punish creatures that grab you — a table-tracked state, not a toggleable modifier set.
An action that damages everyone in your emanation and ends the maelstrom state; affects only other creatures.
Imposes Clumsy on a target after your critical hit; changes only the target's statistics.

companionMod.note: Towering Size: your eidolon becomes Huge instead of Large, and the reach on all its attacks increases to 15 feet. No other statistics change.

crossbow/firearm past the 2nd range increment, if you and your spotter see it
